## 1. Test Architecture Overview

TARS Phase 1 Core MVP utilizes a 4-Tier stratified test architecture designed for rigorous verification of the "Trinity Knowledge Layer", LangGraph StateGraph hybrid orchestration, self-evolving knowledge extraction, and FastAPI real-time streaming backends.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Tier 4: Application & Realistic Scenarios                                       │
│ - tests/tier4_application/test_full_conversation_loop.py (Self-evolving loop)   │
│ - tests/tier4_application/test_multi_tenant_isolation.py (Cross-user isolation) │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Tier 3: E2E API & Real-Time Streaming Endpoints                                │
│ - tests/tier3_e2e_api/test_auth_api.py (Signup, login, JWT access control)      │
│ - tests/tier3_e2e_api/test_config_api.py (GET, PATCH, POST reset TARS config)    │
│ - tests/tier3_e2e_api/test_websocket_streaming.py (/api/v1/chat/ws streaming)  │
│ - tests/tier3_e2e_api/test_sse_streaming.py (POST /api/v1/chat/stream SSE)      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Tier 2: Component Integration & Orchestration                                   │
│ - tests/tier2_integration/test_llm_adapters.py (Gemini, SLM, Circuit Breaker)   │
│ - tests/tier2_integration/test_langgraph_pipeline.py (StateGraph, nodes, memory)│
│ - tests/tier2_integration/test_knowledge_extractor.py (Worker, auto_extracted)  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Shared Test Fixtures: tests/conftest.py                                         │
│ - In-memory SQLite async DB, isolated temporary storage, mock LLM adapters     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 3. How to Execute Tests

Activate your Python virtual environment and run the test suite with `pytest`:

```bash
# Run entire test suite
uv run pytest tests/ -v

# Run by tier
uv run pytest tests/tier2_integration/ -v
uv run pytest tests/tier3_e2e_api/ -v
uv run pytest tests/tier4_application/ -v

# Run with test coverage report
uv run pytest tests/ --cov=tars --cov-report=term-missing
```
